run_extract_weights: run the script to convert a whisper tiny.en.pt checkpoint to safetensors format
summarize_extract_weights: summarize the whisper weight extraction script that converts pytorch checkpoints to safetensors
review_extract_weights: review the script that loads whisper model weights and saves them as safetensors

test_extract_weights: test the whisper weight extraction script by running it against a sample checkpoint file
